dataBoundaryReview: Received JSON values pass only through decoding, strict parsing, binding checks, hashing, structural validation and freezing. Schema names and paths do not trigger imports, evaluation, subprocesses, filesystem reads or network requests. The local module and clock are trusted code; arbitrary caller JavaScript is not sandboxed.
